user.title: Aldi Shopping List
user.description: Choose which stores to search. Pick both to search everywhere at once and see which product is cheapest. The Algolia key is only needed for Aldi: open aldi.nl, press F12, choose Network → Fetch/XHR, search the web shop and copy the value of x-algolia-api-key from the request to algolia.net. Hoogvliet needs no settings; its prices come from the open Checkjebon project and are refreshed daily. Source for Hoogvliet: 'Checkjebon' (default) uses a daily price list, without photos or real product links. 'hoogvliet.nl web shop' gives photos, links and full names, but makes one request per search to Hoogvliet's undocumented API, without their permission. Read the warning in the README first. Picnic: enter the email and password of your Picnic account (only needed if you pick Picnic). If your account uses two-step verification, you will be asked for a code next. This is the undocumented API of the Picnic app; see the warning in the README.

new_week.name: Start new week
new_week.description: Moves to the next week: a list prepared in advance becomes the current one, otherwise a new list with the recurring items is created. The old list is kept.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item to the shopping list.

recurring.name: Recurring
recurring.description: Keep on the list every week.
